pages.raw_title: EV charging payment solutions for your electric fleet | WEX
pages.raw_meta: WEX offers EV fleet public and at-home charging payment solutions and integrated billing and reporting for commercial and government electric fleets.
raw_blocks: End-to-end solutions for your EV fleet transition

Wherever you are in your transition to electric vehicles (EVs), WEX helps you assess, plan, and optimize your mixed-energy or fully electric fleet. One invoice, one platform, and one credit line from your trusted fleet card provider.
Apply for a fleet card
Assess, plan, and optimize with data-driven confidence

Not all vehicle uses are a good fit for electrification. Cutting-edge fleet analytics software from Sawatch Labs , a WEX company, helps you choose the right vehicles for the right jobs and optimize your fleet with electrification assessment, planning, management, and reporting software.
EV Suitability Assessment: Your fleet data helps us to determine if and where EVs meet operational and cost-saving requirements.
Infrastructure Planning: Understand how charging load will impact peak demand at your facilities.
EV Fleet Management: Monitor EV usage to maximize savings, reduce emissions, and keep drivers moving.
Emissions Reporting: Measure vehicle emissions, monitor sustainability goals, and generate monthly compliance reports.

Do you need simple, secure access to public charging during the workday? With WEX EV En Route , use the DriverDash app or the combined WEX Fleet Card with RFID capabilities to eliminate range anxiety with access to WEX’s nationwide charging network.

Nearly 175,000 charging stations in the United States, including AmpUp, Blink, ChargePoint, Electric Era, EV Connect, EvGateway, EVgo, Flo, Greenlane, Integra Energy, Ionna, Mercedes-Benz HPC, Noodoe, PowerFlex, Revel, Shell Recharge,Vialynk (Lynkwell), and more to come.
No more fumbling for the right RFID or learning the nuances of multiple charging apps.
Use DriverDash to find WEX-accepting chargers, view charger status in real-time, start and stop charging sessions, and view receipts
Build a convenient, worry-free route with DriverDash’s EV route-planning feature.
From charger purchase and installation to driver reimbursement using your fleet credit line, WEX EV At-Home helps you save money while keeping your EVs charged and your business moving.
Order chargers and installation* at your drivers’ homes via WEXOnline
Take advantage of lower off-peak residential electricity rates
Approve charging sessions with manual, bulk, or automatic options
Provide fast and accurate driver reimbursement through the WEX PayControl app
Charge into the workday with private site charging
With WEX EV Depot added to your account, you can charge anywhere – public, private, or at home – with your WEX EV RFID or DriverDash app.
Simplify fleet management with one card or app for all of your charging needs.
Save money by sending drivers to your preferred private charging locations, mapped by WEX.
Track all of your charges by vehicle, no matter where they happen.
Discover the EV difference with WEX

Dallas 1 Construction of Tampa, Florida converted its fleet of 55 vehicles to EVs. Using WEX EV At-Home and WEX EV En Route for home and public charging substantially decreased its fuel and maintenance costs.
One credit line, one invoice, one report set, one trusted provider
Sawatch Labs, a WEX company, provides EV suitability assessment, infrastructure planning, EV fleet management and emissions reporting.
Worried about running out of juice? Our en-route charging network of accepting locations makes work-day charges convenient.
Drivers who charge at home receive accurate reimbursement for approved charges. You save time and money.
Charge your EVs on the road or at home and track all of your fueling and charging on one bill and one familiar set of reports .
